description: One review decision the reader made about a memory the agent proposed: WHICH memory and WHAT was decided. The surface reports the decision and never applies it to the host's data — OnReview is the host's contract, and the panel keeps its own copy of the outcome only so the reader sees the row change before the store answers.

members.name: Decision
members.description: What the reader decided about it.

notes: The component reports the decision and never writes the host's store.
